thesis: The page is a field hygrometer: every section plots one real reading on a simplified comfort chart, and the signature dot travels from sticky to inside-the-band as you scroll toward the booking form.

signature.name: Comfort Chart Dot
signature.summary: A CSS/SVG simplified psychrometric chart with a shaded teal comfort band; a coral dot represents the visitor's house and moves along a scroll-driven path through each section's plotted reading chip, settling inside the band at the footer. Hook: data-sw-signature='comfort-chart'.

motion.intro: Chart curves draw in via SVG stroke-dashoffset over 900ms; dot drops to default reading position with ease-out settle. Skippable: chart fully drawn, dot at final position.
stories: dot wipes to new plotted position per section via --ease-io over 900ms
reading chip numerals count up over 600ms with tabular figures
motion.hover: dot scales 1.3x with tooltip; cards lift 2px with subtle shadow
